route_note: Both stays are booked through Fora. Drivers meet you at every airport and port.
days_intro: Everything on the ground and on the water is arranged through Original Senses, my partner in Athens. Your own time is the rest of it.

days.title: Arrive Paros
days.note: A driver meets you at the airport and takes you to Vione. Your car is delivered to the hotel.

days.title: Vione, four nights

days.note: A full day on a private RIB via Antiparos, with swim stops and a Greek picnic. Your luggage comes with you and you step off on Sifnos. A second car is waiting at Verina Astra.

days.title: Verina Astra, five nights
days.note: The island the Greeks go to for food, quiet coves and village walks.

days.note: With a local cook, then the full meal with Greek wine.

stays.headline: Vione, quiet design and your own plunge pool
paras: Vione is the kind of hotel that quietly impresses you. Clean architecture, understated interiors and a calm, adults-focused feel, with every detail considered.
It sits just outside Naoussa, so dinner in the old port is ten minutes away, and with the car you have the beaches on the east coast and the hill villages of Lefkes and Marpissa.

img.caption: Verina Astra, on the cliff at Poulati above Kastro

stays.headline: Verina Astra, a cliff over the Aegean
paras: The most romantic stay on Sifnos: a handful of suites on the cliff at Poulati, with Kastro on foot and Bostani, the hotel's farm-to-table restaurant, for your dress-up dinner.
Sifnos is the island where Greece slows down. Days are about long lunches, pottery villages and swimming at quiet coves, and with the car you can reach all of them.
